description: NaAlB₁₄ is Magnesium tetraboride-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. Na is bonded in a 16-coordinate geometry to sixteen B atoms. There are a spread of Na-B bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.81 Å. Al is bonded to twelve B atoms to form distorted face-sharing AlB₁₂ cuboctahedra. There are a spread of Al-B bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.45 Å. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and six B atoms. There are a spread of B-B bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.87 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and six B atoms. There are a spread of B-B bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.83 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Al and six B atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and one longer (1.84 Å) B-B bond length. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Al, and four B atoms. The B-B bond length is 2.13 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one Na and six B atoms. The B-B bond length is 1.75 Å.
